core_obligations: Apply the composition criterion for derived functors, which reduces the statement to two verifications (proof lines 2284-2285).
Verify that the underlying functors compose, which is the identity of pushforwards along the composite (proof lines 2286-2287).

Verify acyclicity: the pushforward of an injective along f is acyclic for the pushforward along g, by the acyclicity of pushforwards of injectives and the description of higher direct images (proof lines 2288-2292).
proof_roadmap: Compatibility of the underlying functors (proof lines 2286-2287).
difficulty_reason: For morphisms f: X to Y and g: Y to Z of ringed spaces, the lemma identifies the derived pushforward along the composite with the composite of the derived pushforwards as functors between the bounded below derived categories (statement lines 2272-2281). The proof applies the composition criterion for derived functors: the underlying functors compose on the nose, and the only remaining verification is that the pushforward along f sends injectives to objects acyclic for the pushforward along g, which follows from the acyclicity of pushforwards of injectives together with the description of the higher direct images (proof lines 2283-2292). The claim is H2: one criterion plus one acyclicity verification, both named, with the composability of the underlying functors reduced to a cited identity.
